annotation_method: Independent second-pass review: all 740 (source_id, skill_id) pairs (20 records x 37 taxonomy skills) were labeled by a separate direct-text annotation routine (analysis/second_pass.py) driven by a curated adjudication manifest. Labels were decided independently by reading the source-text fields preserved in the analytics dataset (title_raw, excerpt_raw, categories_raw, description_html_raw); taxonomy terms were used only as candidate vocabulary. Matcher predictions (skill_evidence.skills) were NOT read while labeling and are compared only afterwards by compare_with_predictions(...). Supported labels cite exact quotes with half-open offsets verified as field[char_start:char_end] == exact_quote; not_supported means no explicit positive evidence in the reviewed fields (never that the person or job lacks the skill) and lists reviewed_fields; uncertain labels carry the ambiguous quote when text exists plus a human_review_question. Boundary and negative-requirement cases are documented per label: java vs javascript, git vs github, AI in company/category context, and 'No prior experience in AI is required'. This artifact is a DRAFT second pass (annotation_status: draft_second_pass) that REQUIRES human review (human_review_required: true); it is NOT gold and NOT human-reviewed, and no matcher or taxonomy rule was changed.
